answers.question: What changed, and how much did predicted drag fall?

facts.text: The original car was estimated at 621.70 newtons of air resistance; the changed car at 600.97 newtons (3.333% less). Lower resistance is the goal.
The biggest actual movement was 32.174 mm, using Combined sedan research morphs. The research replay opens at true scale. Orange in the Change view marks movement; it is not heat.
The protected part of the car, including the passenger cabin, stayed exactly in place.
